paragraphs: Locution Systems sells automated fire station alerting and automated dispatching, with the voice database stored on site at each station rather than in the cloud. Phase 2 introduced Complete Human Voice technology, described as clear, consistent, and concise dispatches with no reliance on cloud connectivity. Phase 3 adds Full View technology, with file validation and the ability to update or roll back software versions and configuration settings.
Dispatchers keep their existing process and interact with the CAD as before, and Locution automates the audio, paging, and alerts once the dispatch is committed.

Locution Systems says it has focused on two goals since 1993: fire station alerting that saves lives and property, and the health and safety of first responders. Resources on the site include a sample RFP document for fire and EMS station alerting systems, a product brochure, and a page on fire department grants.

quote.text: Phase 3 automated dispatching and alerting that saves lives and property
